blocks.html:
All air filters shall be kept free of excess dust and combustible material. Unit filters shall be renewed or cleaned when the resistance to airflow has increased to two times the original resistance or when the resistance has reached a value of recommended replacement by the manufacturer. A permanently installed draft gauge or differential pressure transmitter shall be provided for all systems equal to or greater than 4000 cfm (1.89 m 3 /s).
Section MC 606: Smoke Detection Systems Control
